notes.title: Launch discount soon over!
notes.content:
Hey there [b][u]beautiful[/u][/b] humans!

[h1]I just wanted to inform you guys that the launch discount will run for about a day more now![/h1]
So if you want to grab a copy of the game at a discounted rate this is the last chance for now.

[h1]What am I currently working on? Nice of you to ask![/h1]
I am currently working on adding a co-op experience (not versus each other), this will also be a singleplayer experience.
More specifics on how exactly that will work will be available at a later point once I have smoothed out the experience a bit.
The current draft is that it will focus around avoiding bombs with puzzle elements that reacts to if its played alone or with friends.

[h1]Why?[/h1]
Well, being a multiplayer game is all fine and dandy, but given that this would assume a lively community this could quickly turn into a waiting game, which is no fun!
So I am adding a secondary gameplay experience that probably is not the same as the multiplayer experience.

[h1]Want to be involved with what I am working on?[/h1]
Join us at [url=discord.gg/ZgYCCFE]Discord[/url]. Follow me on [url=https://twitter.com/ArdoetiaProd]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/Ardoetia/]Facebook[/url].

notes.title: 1.0.2 Graphical changes and bugfixes.
notes.content:
[h1][b]Changes:[/b][/h1]
[list] [*] Fixed an excessive server side cleanup that could in some cases cause disconnection.
[*] Changed a ton of textures to more unique textures.
[*] Fixed a gamebreaking bug where you were constantly stalking, eh, spectating fellow players even when alive.
[*] Fixed bugs wtih the new network logic (should now no longer be resistant to this change.)
[*] Fixed a misbehaving version control (that blocks you from playing if you do not have the newest version to avoid bugs) so that it should no longer be fighting you to play even when you have the newest version.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.1 Minor patch.
notes.content:
This is just a small cleanup patch.

[b]Changes:[/b]
Changed some network logic to reduce the clutter (Changed some legacy code)
Changed a few graphical assets.

Happy gaming :)

notes.title: LAUNCH!!
notes.content:
Hi there [b]fantastic human![/b] are you having a great day?! I am!

[h1][b]WE HAVE LAUNCHED[/b][/h1]

Fun times ahead! Grab a copy of the game and play with your friends!

[h1]So... What now?[/h1]

With this I am happy to announce our [url=https://trello.com/b/o22yq8Ez]Trello![/url] where you guys can see the future plans and progress! Its a bit empty for now, but that will change when I have a better grasp of the needed features.

I hope you guys will have an amazing time and that we get more life on our [url=https://discord.gg/ZgYCCFE]Discord![/url]

I really hope to have an amazing relationship with you all, and that we can have a great journey into the development of this and future games!

[h1]But why would I use [u]my[/u] money on this?[/h1]

You want to play a fun intense game with friends!

If you want to support and help a new developer, that wants to give the best that he can?

Not enough?
Ok, well I can tell a bit about myself then, I am from Norway.
I have a couple of years of game dev university.
Ardoetia Productions is oriented around transparency and ethical business practices and want to keep you in the loop at all times.

Follow us at [url=https://twitter.com/ArdoetiaProd]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/Ardoetia/?ref=bookmarks]Facebook[/url]

notes.title: Launch hype!
notes.content:
[h1][b]We are closing in on launch[/b][/h1]
Hi there [b][u]beautiful[/u][/b] humans!

There is now a new trailer that has more up to date content!
I am looking forward to see what you guys think of the game, and I am looking forward to working with you guys to make the game even better! 
[b]Yes I am not planning on abandoning or otherwise leave the game at the current state![/b]

I will also point out that I do have another game in the works that I previously put a lot of effort into, so you can expect more on that later!

The music in the trailer can be found at [url=https://soundcloud.com/ansenmusic]Soundcloud[/url] if you want to listen to more of his really cool stuff!

There is plans for adding more maps and characters down the line, and to monitor what features you guys feel the game needs!

[url=https://discord.gg/ZgYCCFE]Join us at Discord![/url]
